item.description: Signal class lacks required methods for data view operations. Tests fail with AttributeError: 'Signal' object has no attribute 'f', 'add', 'do' indicating missing method implementations in the Signal class.
item.contract: The Signal class should support data view operations by implementing proper attribute access and method resolution that allows interaction with data constructs like Views, Structs, and Unions. This includes supporting getattr, getitem operations and proper error handling for invalid accesses.

item.description: Reset value validation issues for data constructs. Tests fail with TypeError: Reset value must be a constant-castable expression, not {'a': 1, 'b': 2} indicating improper reset value validation for Signal, Struct, and Union constructs.
item.contract: Data constructs (Signal, Struct, Union) should properly validate reset values to ensure they are constant-castable expressions. Invalid reset values should raise appropriate TypeError exceptions with descriptive messages.

item.description: View class initialization and attribute access problems. Tests fail with TypeError: Cannot index value with '_a' and AssertionError: SyntaxWarning not triggered indicating issues with View class constructors and attribute access, particularly around field validation and indexing.
item.contract: View class should properly handle initialization from Signals and provide appropriate error messages for invalid attribute access and indexing operations. Reserved names should be handled correctly with specific error messages.

item.description: Enum member conversion errors causing Amaranth value to Python boolean conversion failures. Tests fail with TypeError: Attempted to convert Amaranth value to Python boolean indicating issues in enum handling.
item.contract: Signal and related classes should properly handle enum values and prevent conversion to Python booleans. Enum values should be handled appropriately within the context of data views.

item.description: Error message formatting inconsistencies in data views. Tests expect specific error messages but get different ones, requiring consistent error message formatting in data view classes.
item.contract: View and related data classes should produce consistent error messages for field access, indexing, and attribute access with proper formatting and helpful suggestions for users.
